verdict.summary: Round 3 resolves the prior major finding. Section 6.1 now defines the publisher check-run as transport state, authenticates it by dedicated-App identity plus external_id, repository/head SHA, phase, and envelope schema, excludes only the unique fully validated row before every verdict transformation, and fails closed on collisions or mismatches. It also requires adversarial multi-invocation coverage for in-progress, completed, and reopened publisher states, including pagination, duplicate, wrong-App, and prior-green cases. Section 6.2 separately authenticates and excludes legacy resident transport so shadow and resident verdicts remain independent. The design remains explicitly design-only and correctly defers unverified platform assumptions to pre-cutover evidence phases. No new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect is apparent in the diff-scoped design.
